question: On a credential-free substrate class materially different from the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class - multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery amortizes or caches across tasks - can an asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified ARITHMETICALLY BEFORE FREEZE (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on at least one task family; matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms; a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction; honest per-condition counters http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts; and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate) so that the bank is deliverable as a reusable substrate unblocking the flagship inheritance benchmark B2? If the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested, the mandated outcome is a bounded substrate-class negative and nothing is frozen.
hypothesis: The SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class (credential-free deterministic stdlib localhost HTTP; K=8-task sessions; a 48-bit session-scoped binding revealed EXACTLY ONCE in the precursor task's commit receipt, absent from every idempotent channel, and unrecoverable by a memoryless comparator) yields a non-degenerate bank certifiable pre-freeze. Under the frozen benchmark conventions, each of F1-RECORDS and F2-WIDGETS has predicted comparator success_rate 0.875 (140/160) at novelty 0.50 and 0.75 - strictly below the 0.95 ceiling and above the 0.80 floor - and 1.0 at novelty 0.00/0.25, while T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY and PC-EXACT-REPLAY reach 1.0 at every band, with >= 2 of the 4 counter dimensions behaviourally distinct between T and each comparator. The comparator rate (K-1)/K is robust across K in {7,8,9,10} (0.857/0.875/0.889/0.900, all in [0.80,0.95)).
falsifier: F-CEILING/CLASS-DEGENERACY: zero families certify and the non-certification is comparator-attributable (in BOTH families either B-COLD-RE-DERIVE or B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate >= 0.95 at novelty in {0.50,0.75}, or a comparator success_rate < 0.80 at some band), with all validity gates V1-V7 passed and every control at its predicted value -> the SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class is declared degenerate for credential-free stdlib deterministic substrates -> bounded substrate-class negative (the mandate's honest decision-changing outcome). F-LEAK: the one-time binding, or any value sufficient to reconstruct it, is present in any idempotent channel (/session, /task/{i}, non-receipt commit responses, all 400/409 bodies) -> NC-NO-LEAK fires -> MIXED (never a scientific reading). F-GATE: any validity gate V1-V7 fails (nondeterminism, counter inconsistency, frozen-file change, arm protocol violation, stdlib-only breach, matched-manifest mismatch, server-enforcement failure) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a scientific reading.

substrate.class: SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED (materially distinct from EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 mandatory-discovery deterministic REST, which is cited only, never re-run)
substrate.transport: Python stdlib only (http.server / http.client / urllib.request / hashlib / json / hmac / secrets), a single in-process server bound to 127.0.0.1, no persistence beyond process memory, no external network, no credentials, no LLM calls, no browser
substrate.prohibition: EXECUTE MUST NOT import research/runtime/*.py or any other repository module into the measurement path (stdlib-only, frozen). Design-time probes already verified http.server/http.client/urllib.request/hashlib/json/hmac/secrets import under python 3.12.15.
substrate.session: K=8 tasks per session. GET /api/v1/{family}/session -> {session_token, schema, epoch}. session_token is opaque (SHA-256 over server_secret + family + novelty + session_index, 'token' domain) and is NOT the binding; epoch is a monotone construction counter.
substrate.binding: the correct resource_id of the chain task is a one-time 48-bit value = SHA-256(server_secret, family, novelty, session_index, 'binding') hexdigest truncated to 48 bits (12 hex chars). It is revealed EXACTLY ONCE in the precursor task's commit receipt (field next_resource_id), is absent from every idempotent channel, is consumed on first successful use at the chain task, and any stale/foreign/consumed value -> 400. Re-commit of the precursor -> 409 and NEVER re-reveals the binding. NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS additionally requires all session bindings in the run to be pairwise distinct (probe-verified over the full scored matrix: 160 bindings, pairwise distinct).

protocol.GET /api/v1/{family}/session: create/look up the run's session -> {session_token, schema, epoch}; never contains the binding except in the NC-MECHANISM-OFF ablation configuration
protocol.GET /api/v1/{family}/task/{i}: intent {index, intent, resource_id|null, requires_schema, is_chain}; chain task has resource_id=null
protocol.POST /api/v1/{family}/commit: {session_token, task_index, resource_id, payload} -> 200 + receipt on success; 400 invalid/missing/consumed/foreign binding; 409 already-committed (never re-reveals)
protocol.response_invariants: the binding appears ONLY in the precursor's 200 receipt; /session, /task/{i}, ordinary receipts, 400 and 409 bodies must not contain it (NC-NO-LEAK scans them all)

novelty_semantics.0.00: schema_required=false; resource_id explicit in task spec; no chain task; all arms 1.0
novelty_semantics.0.25: schema_required=true (wire schema discovered via /session); resource_id explicit; no chain task; all arms 1.0
novelty_semantics.0.50: schema_required=true + exactly one chain task (index 5; binding revealed in task-4 commit receipt; carry distance 1)
novelty_semantics.0.75: schema_required=true + exactly one chain task (index 7; binding revealed in task-5 commit receipt; carry distance 2)

substrate.novelty_fraction: novelty = fraction of commit parameters not determined by (task spec union frozen grammar): 0.00 -> 0/4; 0.25 -> 1/4 (wire schema); 0.50 -> 2/4 on the chain task (schema + session-scoped binding), 1/4 elsewhere; 0.75 -> 3/4 on the chain task (schema + binding + >1-step context retention), 1/4 elsewhere. The band label is fixed by construction; the certificate gates evaluate at novelty >= 0.50.
substrate.sample: N_SESSIONS=20 per (family x novelty x scored arm) cell -> 160 tasks per cell; 2 families x 4 bands x 4 scored arms = 640 scored sessions (5120 scored tasks); controls add the cells listed in controls; a full double-run of the scored matrix is required
substrate.determinism: one run_seed fixed at EXECUTE start and recorded in provenance.json; per-(family,novelty,session_index) seeds via SHA-256(run_seed, family, novelty, session_index); no process hash(); no wall-clock dependence in outcomes (latency recorded advisory only); NC-DOUBLE-RUN: a second identical-seed run must reproduce every per-task outcome and counter byte-identically
substrate.budget: every arm operates under the same 128-request/session ceiling (NC-EQUAL-BUDGET); max predicted usage is 25/session, so the budget never binds and comparator failure is NOT budget-induced, it is induced by the non-recoverability of the one-time binding (information-theoretic: 2^48 possible values vs 128 requests; ~2^47 worst-case)
substrate.arm_scope: arms interact ONLY through the HTTP surface; access to server-process state, bank files or generator internals is a frozen protocol violation
substrate.benchmark_convention_disclosure: Non-degeneracy here means strictly below the 1.0 correctness ceiling under the memoryless-per-task comparator convention, exactly as in the flagged Product packets. The one-time binding is a small learnable artefact: NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT shows an actor retaining the immediate predecessor receipt finishes 1.0 at carry distance 1. The certificate therefore certifies DYNAMIC RANGE (the B2 blocker), not difficulty for a memory-enabled agent; real-agent difficulty is for B2's LLM arms to measure on this delivered bank. This boundary is disclosed, not hidden.

arms.T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY: treatment (benchmark inheritor stand-in): GET /session once per session; retain ALL in-session context including every commit receipt; capture next_resource_id (the binding) from the precursor receipt; commit each task once using spec/schema ids and the captured binding at the chain task. Predicted success 1.0 all bands; per-session http=17, retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=8, repair_attempts=0.
arms.B-COLD-RE-DERIVE: mandated comparator: before EVERY task GET /session and DISCARD prior task context (no receipt retention); at the chain task the binding is not re-derivable (one-time, 48-bit, non-leaked; ~2^47 guesses vs the 128-request/session budget) -> first commit 400, one repair re-attempt 400 -> chain task failed. Predicted success 0.875 (7/8) at novelty >= 0.50, 1.0 below; per-session http=25 (24 at 0.00/0.25), retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=9 (8 below), repair_attempts=1 (0 below).
arms.B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: mandated comparator: identical request pattern to cold PLUS exactly one local retrieval_call per task over the frozen prior-session store (top-1 similarity; 8 calls/session); at the chain task it retrieves a binding recorded in a DIFFERENT session (stale for the current session's registry; NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS guarantees it is never the current binding) -> 400 -> fail. Predicted success 0.875 at novelty >= 0.50, 1.0 below; per-session http=25 (24 below), retrieval_calls=8, verification_calls=9 (8 below), repair_attempts=1 (0 below).
arms.PC-EXACT-REPLAY: positive control: golden-input executor given the session's exact binding and schema by frozen construction; it performs no wire discovery of schema or binding (only 1 session_get to obtain the opaque session_token, 8 task_reads, 8 commits). Proves the substrate is completable and the scorer is non-degenerate; also the T-liveness anchor. Predicted success 1.0 all bands; per-session http=17, retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=8, repair_attempts=0.

positive_control.expected: success 1.0 at every band in both families; per-session http=17, retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=8, repair_attempts=0

Expected: B-COLD and B-RETRIEVAL both 1.0 at novelty >= 0.5 -> the certificate procedure returns FALSE -> proves the certificate can fire negative and that the one-time asymmetric mechanism (not the bank content or the arm definitions alone) produces the dynamic range

controls.NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT: T minus context retention (captures the receipt then discards it before the chain task). Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5, 1.0 below. Isolates retention as the operative distinction between T and the comparators.
controls.NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING: T with a binding valid in ANOTHER session of the same family; server rejects (400). Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5. Proves session-scoping is server-enforced.
controls.NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION: T with a binding drawn from the OTHER family; server rejects. Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5. Proves family isolation.
controls.NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT: spec-only actor: uses only task specs, no /session, no schema, no receipts. Expected 1.0 at novelty 0.00, 0.0 at novelty >= 0.25. Proves the correct action is NOT determined by the spec alone and that discovery is genuinely required (floor anchor).
controls.NC-NO-LEAK: mechanical scan of EVERY idempotent response body (/session, /task/{i}, non-receipt commit responses, all 400/409 error bodies) for the binding and for any value sufficient to reconstruct it (the precursor receipt is the sole permitted occurrence, exactly once) plus recomputation of the binding entropy (48 bits, floor 40). A single hit -> F-LEAK -> MIXED.
controls.NC-EQUAL-BUDGET: every arm operates under the same 128-request/session ceiling (max predicted usage 25); no arm is starved; the budget never binds (failure is therefore not budget-induced).
controls.NC-NO-SYNTHETIC: the server returns no hints or assistive values (no edit-distance feedback, no partial credit); scoring is exact match of the final committed state against the deterministic ground-truth manifest.
controls.NC-ARM-BLIND-SCORING: the scorer is a pure stateless function over (task_index, final_committed_state) rows only; it never sees arm identity, arm traces, retrieval-store contents or counters. Verified by frozen interface contract.
controls.NC-COUNTER-INTEGRITY: all four counters are re-derived from ONE interleaved execution trace with monotonic request ids. Frozen invariants: http_requests == session_gets + task_reads + commit_requests; verification_calls == commit_requests; repair_attempts <= verification_calls; retrieval_calls > 0 only for B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED. Re-derivation must match the reported counters exactly.
controls.NC-DOUBLE-RUN: the full scored matrix is executed twice with the same run_seed; every per-task outcome and counter must be byte-identical; any divergence -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
controls.NC-K-SWEEP: the construction is re-run at K in {7,9,10} with the identical mechanism; comparators must stay in [0.80,0.95) (probe: 0.8571/0.8889/0.9000). Proves the 0.875 result is not a knife-edge artifact of K=8.
controls.NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT: solvability/depth witness (diagnostic, NOT a certificate gate and NOT in the SUPPORTS control-equality set): a cold-by-policy actor that retains EXACTLY the immediately-prior task's receipt. Expected 1.0 at novelty 0.50 (carry distance 1) and 0.875 at novelty 0.75 (distance 2 exceeds 1-step retention). Proves the chain task is completable (substrate not impossible) and that the benchmark measures a real memory-depth-sensitive discovery-and-carry mechanism. Only the extreme NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT = 0.0 at novelty 0.50 (chain unreachable by ANY memory actor) is a decision-relevant substrate-solvability failure -> MIXED.
controls.NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS: construction invariant (this design's addition): every session binding in the run is pairwise distinct, so a value retrieved from the prior-session store can never be the current session's binding (probe-verified over the full scored matrix: 160/160 pairwise distinct). Gates the meaning of NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED's stale-retrieval failure.

counters.http_requests: every HTTP request issued by the arm (success, failure, repair re-attempts), from the single interleaved trace
counters.retrieval_calls: local retrieval invocations over the frozen prior-session store (B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED only; 0 for all other arms)
counters.verification_calls: commit requests issued = ground-truth checks performed (includes repair re-attempts)
counters.repair_attempts: commit requests issued after an initial failure on the same task

pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.durability_note: The probe files are DESIGN-time ephemeral under /tmp and are NOT interpretation dependencies: the full arithmetic is frozen below and in prereg.md and is re-derivable from those literals; the deterministic freezer hashes request.json/spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json themselves.
pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.closed_form: At novelty <= 0.25 no chain task exists and every task's resource_id is spec-explicit -> all arms 1.0. At novelty >= 0.5 each session has exactly ONE chain task whose correct resource_id is the one-time 48-bit binding; T and PC hold the binding, so their session rate is 8/8 = 1.0; B-COLD and B-RETRIEVAL cannot recover the binding (~2^47 guesses vs a 128-request budget; no idempotent channel reveals it; prior-session-store values are never the current binding by NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS), so exactly the chain task fails and their session rate is (K-1)/K = 7/8 = 0.875. Per-cell rate = 20 sessions x 7/8 / 20 = 140/160 = 0.875.

per_cell_success.novelty_0.00: T=1.0, COLD=1.0, RETRIEVAL=1.0, PC=1.0 (160/160 each family)
per_cell_success.novelty_0.25: T=1.0, COLD=1.0, RETRIEVAL=1.0, PC=1.0 (160/160 each family)
per_cell_success.novelty_0.50: T=1.0, PC=1.0; COLD=0.875 (140/160), RETRIEVAL=0.875 (140/160) - both families
per_cell_success.novelty_0.75: T=1.0, PC=1.0; COLD=0.875 (140/160), RETRIEVAL=0.875 (140/160) - both families

pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.gate_evaluation: F1-RECORDS and F2-WIDGETS BOTH certify: COLD=0.875 < 0.95 AND RETRIEVAL=0.875 < 0.95 at novelty 0.50 and 0.75; min arm correctness = 0.875 >= 0.80; T/PC anchor 1.0. Margin 0.075 below the ceiling and 0.075 above the floor. Boundary note: all rates are exact rationals with denominator 20*K; (K-1)/K for K in {7,8,9,10} never equals 0.95 or 0.80, so threshold-boundary ambiguity is impossible.
pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.behavioral_distinction: success margin T-COLD = T-RETRIEVAL = 0.125 >= 1/K at novelty >= 0.5; counter dimensions: T vs COLD distinct on http (17<25), verification (8<9), repair (0<1) -> 3/4; T vs RETRIEVAL distinct on all 4 (17<25, 0<8, 8<9, 0<1) -> 4/4. Rule requires >= 2 of 4.
pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.k_sweep: K=7: 0.8571; K=8: 0.8750; K=9: 0.8889; K=10: 0.9000; all strictly in [0.80,0.95) -> non-degeneracy is not knife-edge on K.
pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.control_predictions: PC=1.0; NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT=0.875; NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING=0.875; NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION=0.875; NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT 1.0 at 0.00 / 0.0 at >= 0.25; NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT 1.0 at 0.50 / 0.875 at 0.75; NC-MECHANISM-OFF: COLD=RETRIEVAL=1.0 -> certificate FALSE (negative branch inhabited).
pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.novelty_monotonicity: NOT preregistered and NOT gated: identical 0.875 at bands 0.50 and 0.75 is expected by construction (the same one-time-binding failure mechanism at both carry distances).

contamination_controls.cache_vs_current_session: T's retained context contains only {session schema, explicit spec-derived resource ids, the current session's receipts}; B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED's store contains ONLY values from sessions OTHER than the current one (frozen prior-session store); no arm receives the current session's binding except through the single server-issued precursor receipt (T/PC).
contamination_controls.server_enforced: the server validates every resource_id against the live session registry and consumes the binding on first use; stale/foreign/consumed -> 400 (verified by NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING, NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION, NC-NO-LEAK).
contamination_controls.matched_manifests: identical task manifests per (family, novelty) across ALL arms; arms differ ONLY in frozen policy, never in stimuli.
contamination_controls.cache_only_oracle: a store-only/cache-only actor completes 0 tasks at novelty >= 0.25 (behavioural proxy NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT); no test-session answer is obtainable from any store.
contamination_controls.arm_blind_scoring: the scorer sees only (task_index, final_committed_state) rows; no arm identity, traces, stores or counters.
contamination_controls.binding_uniqueness: NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS guarantees prior-session-store values are never the current session's binding.

measurement_validity.validity_class: deterministic closed-form construction measurement on a frozen-literal bank; no LLM, no stochastic model, no network beyond loopback
measurement_validity.gate_classes: Two classes are deliberately separated. VALIDITY GATES V1-V7 decide whether the measurement is interpretable at all. SCIENTIFIC RATE MEASUREMENTS (per-cell arm success rates) are genuine measured outputs and are NOT equality-frozen: a measured rate that differs from the pre-freeze prediction is evaluated by the section decision_rule, never auto-classified as invalid, unless it co-occurs with a V1-V7 failure. This structural separation is the correction of the prior same-mandate designs' defect (an equality gate on every cell that made the falsifying branch unreachable).
validity_gates: V1: packet immutability (frozen request/spec/prereg/design_review untouched) and stdlib-only measurement path
V2: NC-DOUBLE-RUN byte-identical per-task outcomes and counters
V3: NC-NO-LEAK clean and binding entropy recomputed >= 40 bits
V4: NC-COUNTER-INTEGRITY trace re-derivation matches the reported counters
V6: matched manifests across arms and no arm protocol violation
V7: NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING and NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION confirm server-enforced session/family scope and binding consumption
measurement_validity.representation_loss: executors are deterministic stand-ins for real agents; the certificate certifies the SUBSTRATE's dynamic range under the frozen benchmark conventions, not any real-agent capability. Real-agent economics remain for the B2 benchmark to measure on this bank.

threats.circularity_substrate_vs_arm: addressed by NC-MECHANISM-OFF (disabling only the one-time mechanism, with identical bank and arms, flips comparators to 1.0 and the certificate to FALSE - probe-verified), by NC-NO-LEAK + 48-bit entropy (non-re-derivability mechanically verified over the HTTP surface), and by the information-theoretic argument that the comparator policy is the mandate-named memoryless-per-task benchmark convention and its per-chain-task failure is forced by 48 bits of unrecoverable state, not by an arm-tuning choice.
threats.ceiling_baselines: both comparators predicted at 0.875, 0.075 below the 0.95 ceiling and 0.075 above the 0.80 floor; the excluded REST class is cited, NOT re-run (mandate).
threats.floor_baselines: NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT anchors the true floor at 0.0 for novelty >= 0.25, so 0.875 is not a floor artifact.
threats.treatment_comparator_identity: T, COLD and RETRIEVAL differ in frozen policy and in predicted success rate and in counter dimensions (T vs COLD 3/4, T vs RETRIEVAL 4/4; rule >= 2/4); identity collision is impossible unless a validity gate fails.
threats.contamination: see contamination_controls; scored via server-enforced validation plus the cache-only-actor proxy and NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS.
threats.nondeterminism: single run_seed, no process hash(), no wall-clock dependence, NC-DOUBLE-RUN gate.
threats.learnability_of_binding: disclosed in substrate.benchmark_convention_disclosure and measured by NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT: the 0.875 comparator rate is relative to the memoryless-per-task convention, and the certificate certifies dynamic range, not difficulty for a memory-enabled agent.

decision_rule.family_certifies: A family certifies iff, at novelty >= 0.50, B-COLD-RE-DERIVE < 0.95 AND B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED < 0.95, AND every scored arm (T, COLD, RETRIEVAL, PC) has success_rate >= 0.80 at every band, AND behavioural distinction holds (at least 2 of the 4 counter dimensions http_requests/retrieval_calls/verification_calls/repair_attempts distinct between T and each comparator AND success margins T-COLD >= 1/8 AND T-RETRIEVAL >= 1/8 at novelty >= 0.5).
decision_rule.SUPPORTS: >= 1 family certifies AND all controls equal their predicted values (PC=1.0; NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT=0.875; NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING=0.875; NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION=0.875; NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT 1.0 at 0.00 / 0.0 at >= 0.25; NC-MECHANISM-OFF -> certificate FALSE) AND validity gates V1-V7 pass -> deliver the certified bank (task manifests, stdlib HTTP protocol, executor policy definitions, scored evidence, contamination certificate) as a reusable substrate for the B2 benchmark; C-MEAS-VALID substrate-validity evidence only, no claim status change, no promotion.
decision_rule.FALSIFIES: zero families certify AND the non-certification is comparator-attributable - in BOTH families either a comparator success_rate >= 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 (the certificate is unsatisfiable on the frozen class) or a comparator success_rate < 0.80 at some band (the bank is below floor) - AND validity gates V1-V7 pass AND every control equals its predicted value -> bounded substrate-class negative: the SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class is closed for credential-free stdlib deterministic substrates -> flag the Global Director that the flagship benchmark class requires credentialed substrates or a changed product thesis (the mandate's stated honest decision-changing outcome). Reachability witness: the pre-registered NC-MECHANISM-OFF configuration ablates ONLY the one-time mechanism from the identical substrate, bank and arm policies, and under the frozen certificate it returns unsatisfiable (comparators 1.0 >= 0.95 -> FALSE, probe-verified), so the negative branch is demonstrably inhabited and the procedure is non-vacuous; any realized degeneration of the mechanism-intact frozen class maps here because the per-cell rates are measured outputs, not equality-frozen values.
decision_rule.MIXED: validity gates V1-V7 pass and the classification is neither SUPPORTS nor FALSIFIES: exactly one family certifies while the other fails (partial dynamic range); OR a treatment-side failure (T < 0.80 or PC < 1.0) makes the bank undeliverable without closing the substrate class; OR a control does not equal its predicted value (e.g. NC-NO-LEAK fires -> F-LEAK, or NC-MECHANISM-OFF fails to flip to FALSE); OR the solvability witness NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT = 0.0 at novelty 0.50 (chain task unreachable by ANY memory actor -> substrate-solvability failure). NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT is otherwise a NOT-a-gate diagnostic: its other deviations are reported but do not by themselves change the classification -> the bank is not deliverable as certified; emit the exact repair list.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: any validity gate V1-V7 fails (infrastructure failure, double-run divergence, counter inconsistency, frozen-file modification, arm protocol violation, stdlib-only breach, matched-manifest mismatch, server-enforcement failure) -> no scientific reading; record the diagnosis and the smallest unblocking next action. Infrastructure/substrate failure is never encoded as scientific falsification.
decision_rule.boundary_note: per-cell rates are exact rationals with denominator 20*K; (K-1)/K for K in {7,8,9,10} equals neither 0.95 nor 0.80, so the < 0.95 and >= 0.80 inequalities cannot land on their boundaries.

product_consequence_positive: Runtime delivers a certified, reusable asymmetric-discovery task bank (frozen manifests, stdlib HTTP protocol, executor policy definitions, scored evidence, contamination certificate) that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark B2: external agents can be benchmarked on a substrate where cold re-derivation and retrieval-shaped baselines score 0.875 (off the 1.0 ceiling, above the 0.80 floor) while an amortized inheritor scores 1.0 at strictly lower http/verification/repair cost. B2 was previously gated on 'benchmark degeneracy: cold/retrieval at the 1.0 ceiling on the tested class'. No product promotion and no claim status change; C-MEAS-VALID substrate-validity evidence only, bounded to two task families on a credential-free stdlib substrate.
product_consequence_negative: If zero families certify (comparator-attributable, all gates and controls clean), record a bounded substrate-class negative for the SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class: credential-free stdlib deterministic substrates with one-time session-scoped discovery cannot deliver benchmark dynamic range; the flagship B2 class is closed on this substrate family and the factory must seek credentialed substrates or change the product thesis. Nothing is promoted and no claim is advanced. If a validity gate fails, deliver the exact repair list instead of a bank. The freeze-nothing escape clause is preserved for any unsatisfiable variant.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both extremes. Positive: B2 - currently gated on benchmark degeneracy - receives a certified non-degenerate substrate plus a mechanically verified contamination certificate, and downstream lanes can preregister this substrate for C-FRESHNESS / C-DELTA-REPAIR / C-LLM-INHERIT work. Negative: the certification attempt closes the credential-free stdlib one-time-session substrate family with a bounded negative, forcing the credentialed-substrate or thesis-change decision instead of further degenerate benchmark cycles. This packet also corrects the prior same-mandate attempts' structural defect (equality gates on every scored cell made the falsifying branch unreachable) by separating validity gates from measured scientific rates, adds NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS, exposes the closed-form certificate arithmetic, and re-verifies every claim with fresh DESIGN-time probes (the predecessor's probes no longer exist). Claims that would NOT change any decision are explicitly not made: the bank is not a claim about real-agent capability, and novelty monotonicity is not preregistered.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four branches are arithmetically reachable at measure time and were re-verified by DESIGN-time probes. SUPPORTS: both families are predicted to certify (comparators 0.875 in [0.80,0.95), T/PC 1.0, distinction 3/4 and 4/4 counter dims, margins 0.125 >= 1/8); the probe evaluates the exact frozen rule and returns certificate_satisfiable=true. FALSIFIES: the certificate procedure is a non-vacuous check that demonstrably returns FALSE - the pre-registered NC-MECHANISM-OFF configuration ablates only the one-time mechanism from the identical substrate, bank and arms and drives both comparators to 1.0 >= 0.95 -> certificate FALSE (probe-verified mech_off_flips=true); the excluded REST class independently returned the same FALSE. The primary comparator rates are MEASURED OUTPUTS, not equality-frozen values, so any realized degeneration of the mechanism-intact class maps to FALSIFIES rather than to invalidity. MIXED is reachable via NC-NO-LEAK firing (F-LEAK), any control failing to discriminate, a treatment-side failure (T < 0.80 or PC < 1.0), or exactly one family certifying. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via any validity gate V1-V7 failure.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The two mandated comparators are distinct frozen policies with distinct predicted counter profiles (retrieval 8 vs 0) and identical off-ceiling predicted success 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5, distinguishable from the 1.0 treatment, from the 1.0 low-novelty band, from the 0.95 ceiling (margin 0.075) and from the 0.80 floor (margin 0.075). The floor is independently anchored at 0.0 by NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT. No arm pair is guaranteed identical: success margins T-COLD = T-RETRIEVAL = 0.125 and at least 2 of 4 counter dimensions differ between T and each comparator (3/4 vs COLD, 4/4 vs RETRIEVAL). The 0.95 ceiling is the mandate's own threshold; the excluded REST class is cited, not re-run. The K-sweep shows the comparator rate is not pinned to a single construction parameter, and the boundary note shows rates cannot land on the 0.95/0.80 thresholds.

control_sensitivity.reason: Each control has a distinct predicted value detecting a distinct failure mode, all verified at DESIGN time: PC-EXACT-REPLAY 1.0 (substrate completable, scorer non-degenerate); NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT 0.0 at novelty >= 0.25 (discovery genuinely required, true floor); NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT 0.875 (retention is the operative T property, exactly -0.125 vs T); NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING 0.875 and NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION 0.875 (server-enforced scope); NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT 1.0 at 0.50 / 0.875 at 0.75 (substrate solvable and memory-depth-sensitive); NC-MECHANISM-OFF flips the certificate to FALSE (negative branch inhabited at measure time - probe-verified); NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS pairwise-distinct 160/160 bindings (probe-verified); NC-K-SWEEP non-degenerate at K in {7,9,10} (probe-verified); NC-NO-LEAK + entropy >= 40 bits (48 actual); NC-DOUBLE-RUN; NC-COUNTER-INTEGRITY. No control is tautological or impossible, and each is scored by the exact same arm-blind scorer.

treatment_liveness.reason: T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY is a deterministic stdlib actor whose exact control flow (bootstrap /session once, retain all receipts, capture next_resource_id from the precursor receipt, commit each task once with the captured binding) is executable against the transport proven live by probe_transport (session 200, precursor receipt 200 revealing the binding, chain commit 200 with the valid binding, stale/foreign 400), and the rule-level simulation reaches 1.0 with the predicted counter vector (http=17, retr=0, verif=8, repair=0). PC-EXACT-REPLAY is the T-liveness anchor: T must equal PC at 1.0, so a broken receipt-capture loop drops T and trips the distinction gate (SUPPORTS becomes unreachable with a dead treatment). This is a measurement-substrate treatment (a benchmark inheritor stand-in), not a SPIDER-kernel integration, so no kernel dependency gates it. EXECUTE additionally hardens liveness via NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT (T's retention actually matters).
